methodology.cpu: Upstream total, script, and paint durations. 15 samples per case; selection uses 25. The reversed-order repeat uses 30 per case. No concurrent builds, tests, profiles, or timing runs.
methodology.memory: performance.measureUserAgentSpecificMemory().bytes / 1024 / 1024 after forced GC; three samples per case. Final and initial/reference values come from separate batches.
methodology.references: Solid 1.9.3 and the tracked vanilla implementation from the recorded harness. Reference CPU values were collected before the final runtime optimizations. Fict uses immutable state and direct selection equality; Solid uses per-row signals and a selector.
